label: Product Design
description: Design a new product for a user group or problem. Tests empathy, creativity and structured thinking.

label: Product Improvement
description: Improve an existing product. Tests product sense, user segmentation and prioritization.

label: Product Strategy
description: Market entry, competition, build/buy/partner, long-term bets.

label: Metrics & Analytics
description: Define success, pick a North Star, design dashboards and experiments.

label: Root Cause & Execution
description: A metric dropped — why? Trade-offs, launch decisions, prioritization under constraints.

label: Estimation
description: Guesstimates and market sizing. Tests structured decomposition and sanity checking.

label: Behavioral & Leadership
description: Conflict, failure, influence without authority, ownership. Tests self-awareness and leadership.

label: Technical
description: How things work, system design for PMs, APIs, trade-offs with engineering.

label: Pricing & Monetization
description: Price a product, design a business model, grow revenue.

label: AI / ML Product
description: Build and evaluate AI-powered products: LLMs, recommendations, trust and safety.
